headline: Benchmarking automated annotation against explicit reference standards
label: Benchmarking Automated Annotation Methods
summary: Evolving ground truth and expanding gene prediction beyond mammals make continuous, reproducible benchmarking of annotation methods necessary.
synthesis: The common thread across these items is evaluation of automated sequence and structure annotation against explicit reference standards. LAFA is the only item here that treats this as a longitudinal problem, proposing a persistent, containerized benchmarking server that re-evaluates protein function prediction methods continuously as ground truth evolves. Tiberius extends a deep-learning ab initio gene predictor to lineage-specific models across six eukaryotic clades, benchmarked on 33 species. BioAutoML-FAST contributes a web platform hosting reusable, benchmarked models for nucleotide and amino acid sequences. The published study evaluates AlphaFold 3, Foldseek and InterProScan scores as indicators of gene model quality across three fungal and protist genomes, using manually curated references. These contributions are heterogeneous: several supply benchmarked resources or models, while only LAFA targets reference drift directly.
